biography:
Driven by a passion for merging technology with commercial real estate, my career has been focused on building projects at this intersection. With a proven track record, I have overseen more than $4.9 billion in commercial real estate transactions, contributing a wealth of expertise to numerous acquisitions and land development projects. 

Currently, as Head of Acquisitions at Verrus, I am leading efforts to expand our national data center platform by driving site selection, strategic acquisitions, and investment approvals. My focus is on identifying, negotiating, and securing key sites that align with Verrus' mission to reimagine data centers as active energy assets, working closely with internal teams, investors, and the Board of Directors to execute on high-impact opportunities. Previously, as the Senior Acquisition Manager on Microsoft's Infrastructure Planning & Acquisition team, I lead efforts in the strategic development and acquisition of data centers, driving the expansion of our digital infrastructure. This role leverages my extensive experience gained at Amazon, where I was integral to a period of remarkable growth, more than doubling the company's real estate portfolio and establishing a robust logistical network. My contributions have been pivotal in shaping the infrastructure that supports the rapid scaling and market dominance of both Microsoft and Amazon in the commercial real estate and technology sectors.

Prior, during my tenure at JLL and Bank of America, I honed my skills in brokerage and investment banking. This experience was crucial for mastering strategic partnerships and thriving in high-stakes situations, laying the groundwork for my success in tech-centric real estate.

I'm passionate about building communities within and outside the CRE sphere. My leadership as Co-President of 'Women at Amazon' has propelled Amazon's largest ERG to support over 30,000 members globally. Within CRE, my involvement with NAIOP and CREW Seattle is multifaceted, encompassing leadership roles and active participation in committees and forums. This includes serving on NAIOP's national Executive Board, being a Research Foundation Visionary, and engaging in National Forums, alongside my role as Events Director for CREW Seattle. These positions underscore my dedication to industry advancement and nurturing inclusive, vibrant community networks.
